fields.title: Little Nile Cotton T-Shirt
fields.description: Soft and breathable Egyptian cotton T-shirt, perfect for kids’ daily wear. Designed to keep children cool and comfortable during hot days. A must-have basic for every child’s wardrobe.

fields.title: Cairo Kids Slim Jeans
fields.description: Trendy slim-fit jeans designed for comfort and active kids. Made with durable fabric that withstands rough play and frequent washes. A stylish piece for both school and casual outings.

fields.title: Pharaoh Kids Party Dress
fields.description: Elegant cotton dress with Egyptian-inspired patterns, ideal for parties. Lightweight and comfortable, ensuring kids can enjoy their special occasions. Comes in vibrant colors loved by children.

fields.title: Mini Giza Polo Shirt
fields.description: Casual polo shirt for kids, crafted from high-quality cotton. The breathable material makes it perfect for summer wear. A versatile piece that works for school or outings.

fields.title: Oasis Kids Hoodie
fields.description: Warm and stylish hoodie, perfect for school and playtime. Made with soft inner lining to keep children cozy in cooler evenings. The durable stitching ensures long-lasting wear.

fields.title: Delta Kids Cargo Shorts
fields.description: Durable shorts with pockets, designed for active kids. The lightweight fabric allows freedom of movement for outdoor play. Ideal for summer adventures and casual wear.

fields.title: Lotus Kids Linen Dress
fields.description: Lightweight linen dress, ideal for summer in Egypt. Breathable and soft to keep children comfortable all day. Designed with playful patterns that kids adore.

fields.title: Alex Kids Sneakers
fields.description: Comfortable sneakers designed for kids’ everyday activities. Built with cushioned soles for maximum comfort and support. Perfect for running, playing, and long school days.

fields.title: Sands Kids Pajama Set
fields.description: Cozy cotton pajama set for a comfortable night’s sleep. Gentle on the skin and suitable for sensitive children. Designed with fun prints to make bedtime enjoyable.

fields.title: Luxor Kids Undershirt Pack
fields.description: Pack of 3 soft undershirts made with pure Egyptian cotton. Breathable fabric ensures comfort throughout the day. A practical choice for layering in all seasons.
